messages:
andrea: Heads up — after yesterday's kernel-picker roll (v2) I'm seeing host-side p95 jump ~30ms for short chats. Profiling looks like tokenization/request-parse time increased, not GPU.

andrea: Snapshot from perf trace:
```
host_parse_ms p50: 1.2  p95: 9.8  p99: 14.2
tokenize_ms  p50: 0.4  p95: 5.6  p99: 9.1
kvcache_lookup_ms p50: 0.6 p95: 0.9
total_host_overhead_ms p95: 78 (+30)
```

raj: Hmm. Kernel-picker changed batch sizing heuristics, right? Could be we're selecting a "mini-batch" path that forces extra pre-tokenization. Which commit?

andrea: @raj yeah commit d8f4c1 — added "prefer_small_batches" when seq_len < 256. Also changed kernel fingerprinting to peek at first 64 tokens pre-parse.

maya: That pre-peek sounds suspicious — peeking forces full parse of headers in grpc/http2 path, adding syscall/allocs. Can you attach a flamegraph?

andrea: Flamegraph: top shows repeated utf8-normalize + proto-unpack in ingress path. The pre-peek path is invoking our legacy token adapter. Small snippet:
```
ingress -> prepeek() -> proto_unwrap() -> utf8_norm -> token_adapter_old
```

lucas: I saw a similar tail on canary last week. The old token_adapter does lots of memcpys and calls into ICU. We switched to token_adapter_v2 in most fast paths earlier — why is pre-peek routing to old adapter?

raj: Kernel fingerprint step returns "legacy" for small inputs because it hashes first N bytes and uses an older suffix rule. We probably missed mapping for "grpc-framing" header shapes.

andrea: Quick repro: curl to gateway with small chat payload shows extra 4 syscalls per request vs baseline:
```
strace -e trace=read,write,open -- ./req_sim
read(3,...)  write(1,...)  open("/usr/lib/icu/..", O_RDONLY)  ...
```

deploy-bot: rolled back kernel-picker d8f4c1 on eng-runtime/canary at 12:07 UTC.

andrea: After rollback p95 back to baseline within 10 minutes. Confirmed KV lookup unchanged; it's pure parse/tokenization overhead.

maya: For next attempt we should:
- stop pre-peek forcing token_adapter selection; instead use header-only quick-check
- update kernel fingerprint mapping for grpc framings
- add unit test for small-request path to prevent regressions

lucas: Also consider adding a fast-path GC-buffer that avoids ICU for inputs that are ascii-only (common in chat short prompts).

andrea: Filing a small follow-up PR with tests. I'll paste perf regression blamelist: d8f4c1 -> a7b3e -> 9c1f2. Marking P0 until fixed on dedicated clusters.

raj: Thx — I'll run stateless canary with pre-peek disabled.

andrea: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
